Xander de Vries  
New York, NY | (555) 123-4567 | xander.devries@email.com  

A senior data science consultant with 9 years of experience delivering scalable analytics solutions to tech-driven organizations. Specialized in designing data pipelines, building predictive models, and translating complex insights into actionable strategies. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, optimize business processes through A/B testing, and architect data systems that support high-traffic applications.
